basic_details.scholarship_name: KFUPM Graduate STEM Fellowships in Engineering & Physical Sciences
basic_details.offering_entity: King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals (KFUPM)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals (Dhahran, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Restricted to STEM and Engineering disciplines: Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Robotics, Chemistry, Physics, Mathematics.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: Hundreds of fully funded Graduate Assistantships (GA) and Research Assistantships (RA) awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Extensive representation: Hundreds of Pakistani graduate students currently enrolled on full fellowships
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Master's of Science (MS): 2 years; PhD: 3 to 4 years

nationality_requirements: Open to international male and female applicants worldwide (Pakistani students fully eligible)
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: 4-year Bachelor's degree in engineering/science for MS applicants; 2-year Master's degree in engineering/science for PhD applicants from recognized universities.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.00/4.00 CGPA for Master's; minimum 3.00/4.00 CGPA for PhD; competitive applicants in core engineering tracks typically have 3.4+ CGPA.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Undergraduate major must match or be closely related to the intended graduate program.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final semester (final degree certificate must be submitted upon enrollment).
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not required; research experience and publications strongly preferred for PhD.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.0 (or TOEFL iBT minimum 68) mandatory. Computer Science and AI tracks often expect IELTS 6.5 / TOEFL 79.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: None; all graduate courses, examinations, and research at KFUPM are conducted 100% in English.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open to both male and female applicants (female graduate students have dedicated campus housing and facilities).
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: GRE General test is strongly recommended for MS and required for PhD engineering programs (competitive quantitative score: 156+).

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver for all credit hours throughout the degree program.

admission_application_fee.details: Nominal online application processing fee (SAR 100 / ~PKR 7,500) paid during portal submission.

accommodation.details: Free furnished air-conditioned bachelor housing provided on campus (shared room for MS, private single room for PhD).

monthly_stipend.details: Tax-free monthly living stipend paid directly to the student's Saudi bank account.
monthly_stipend.amount: SAR 2,500 / month (MS) (~PKR 185,000 / month); SAR 4,000 / month (PhD) (~PKR 295,000 / month)

airfare.details: Prepaid round-trip economy airfare from Pakistan to Dammam/Dhahran upon initial enrollment, and return flight home upon graduation.

visa_fee.details: Saudi Student Iqama / Visa processing fees and government residency cards covered by the university.

health_insurance.details: Free comprehensive primary and specialized medical and dental care at the KFUPM Medical Center on campus and affiliated hospitals.

food_allowance.details: Heavily subsidized meals available at the university student cafeteria (high-quality meals for SAR 4 to 8 / meal).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Free university-issued textbooks and laboratory computing equipment provided by the university bookstore.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Generous university research grants (DSR) and funding to present papers at international IEEE/SPE conferences abroad.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Free airport shuttle service between King Fahd International Airport (Dammam) and KFUPM campus.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single Institution: King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals (Dhahran, Saudi Arabia).
participating_institutions: KFUPM (College of Petroleum Engineering & Geosciences, College of Computing & Mathematics, College of Engineering & Physics)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: World Top 10 for Petroleum Engineering and Chemical Engineering; #1 University in the Middle East & Arab Region (QS World Rankings #101).
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's / Master's transcripts (GPA 3.0+), IELTS 6.0+, Statement of Purpose, 3 recommendation letters, GRE General (recommended/required).
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Single integrated application: Applying via the KFUPM Deanship of Graduate Studies portal automatically considers eligible applicants for the fully funded Graduate Assistantship/Fellowship.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Pakistani engineers from UET, NUST, GIKI, and PIEAS are held in extremely high regard at KFUPM; highlighting practical engineering design and strong mathematical foundations produces high acceptance rates.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: KFUPM Deanship of Graduate Studies Online Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the KFUPM graduate admissions portal during the open application cycles (Fall intake: January - February; Spring intake: September - October).
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Register on KFUPM online graduate portal during open window.
2. Fill academic history, upload bachelor's/master's transcripts and degree certificates.
3. Upload valid IELTS (min 6.0) or TOEFL (min 68) test score certificate.
4. Upload GRE General score card (if available; highly recommended).
5. Write Statement of Purpose outlining research interests in engineering/science.
6. Register 3 academic referees who submit online recommendation forms directly.
7. Pay nominal application fee (SAR 100) and submit online application.
8. Departmental graduate committees evaluate files (March - April).
9. Official admission and scholarship award letters issued via portal (May/June).
10. Attest educational documents via HEC, MOFA, and Saudi Cultural Mission (SACM) in Islamabad.
11. Receive Saudi Student Visa authorization and book prepaid flight to Dammam (August).
12. Arrive at KFUPM campus in Dhahran for orientation.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated 1-step routing: Full scholarship is tied directly to graduate admission.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by 3 academic referees via automated secure email links.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose (1-2 pages): Academic background, research experience, proposed research topic at KFUPM, and professional career goals.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: PhD applicants must upload a focused research proposal aligned with KFUPM research centers (e.g. Center of Research Excellence in Renewable Energy, CPG).
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Generally dossier-based; some departments may conduct a short technical Zoom call with prospective thesis advisors.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (6.0) or TOEFL (68) mandatory. GRE General recommended for MS, required for PhD.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: MANDATORY FOR VISA: Degrees and transcripts must be attested by HEC, MOFA, and Saudi Cultural Mission (SACM) in Islamabad/Karachi prior to visa stamping.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online portal submission on KFUPM portal.

important_dates_timeline.application_open_date: January annually for Fall intake; September for Spring intake
important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: Mid-February annually for Fall intake; October for Spring intake
important_dates_timeline.shortlist_announcement: May / June for Fall intake; November / December for Spring intake
important_dates_timeline.visa_application_window: June - July (Saudi Embassy Islamabad / Consulate Karachi)
important_dates_timeline.semester_commencement: Late August / September (Fall Semester) or January (Spring Semester)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Offers two intakes per academic year (Fall and Spring).

selection_process_and_weights.test_scores_weight: 10% (GRE Quantitative score and IELTS score balance)
selection_process_and_weights.financial_need_weight: 0% (All admitted graduate students receive full fellowship)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Departmental Graduate Studies Committees and Deanship of Graduate Studies at KFUPM.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Rigorous academic review ranking applicants by GPA, GRE scores, and research capability in engineering.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~6,000 to 10,000 international applicants across all STEM departments
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: Hundreds of graduate assistantships awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~6.0% to 8.0% (Strong track record of Pakistani engineering admissions)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Solid engineering background, GRE Quantitative 156+, IELTS 6.5, well-defined research interests.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of NUST, UET Lahore, UET Taxila, GIKI, PIEAS, FAST, NED University Karachi, and COMSATS.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, Egypt, India, Nigeria, Bangladesh, Jordan, Sudan.

fake_websites_and_scams: Commercial visa agents claiming they have 'Iqama work visa quotas' for KFUPM. Graduate fellowship admission is strictly granted by the KFUPM Deanship.
Scam agencies demanding thousands of riyals for scholarship placement.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Only the official SAR 100 online application fee is paid directly on the KFUPM portal.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Never hire an agent. All portal interaction is direct.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Degree attestation at Saudi Cultural Mission (SACM) in Islamabad (requires authorized courier agency, approx PKR 15,000 to 30,000).
Medical checkup (Enjaz medical) at approved GAMCA centers in Pakistan (approx PKR 12,000 to 18,000).
Initial settling pocket money buffer before first stipend release.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: Female students cannot apply. (Fact: KFUPM opened all its graduate programs to female students with dedicated on-campus female graduate housing and facilities).
MYTH: You cannot study in English. (Fact: 100% of education and research at KFUPM is conducted in English).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Some third-party sites report outdated stipends; current stipends are SAR 2,500/mo for MS and SAR 4,000/mo for PhD.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain cumulative GPA of at least 3.00/4.00 each semester; dropping below 3.00 results in academic probation and potential loss of fellowship.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical residence on campus in Dhahran.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual evaluations by graduate department academic committee.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars are employed as Graduate Assistants (GA) or Research Assistants (RA) working up to 15-20 hours/week assisting in departmental teaching or research labs as part of their fellowship obligation; outside commercial employment in Saudi Arabia is strictly prohibited.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No mandatory home residency return rule. Many graduates transition directly to lucrative high-paying engineering careers with Saudi Aramco, SABIC, or continue to doctoral studies in the US and Europe.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Duty as Graduate Assistant (15 hrs/week teaching/grading/lab work).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Termination of fellowship upon academic dismissal or disciplinary expulsion.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Subject to strict approval by both academic departments.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum 1 semester extension can be approved by the Deanship for thesis completion.
